Toddler meals

Soft milk rolls

Házi kifli

10 months+ Adjusted 120 min 8 portions

From ten months, break into small pieces with a soft crust. Do not let the rolls dry hard.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 250 g Plain wheat flour (Ordinary bread flour or plain flour)
  • 150 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized and lukewarm)
  • 1 teaspoon Dried yeast (About 3 g)
  • 1 teaspoon Mashed ripe apple (Feeds the yeast)
  • 1 tablespoon Mild oil (Rapeseed or sunflower)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Stir the yeast and mashed apple into the lukewarm milk.
  2. Mix in the flour and oil to make a soft dough.
  3. Knead briefly, then cover and leave until puffy, which can take over an hour.
  4. Shape eight small rolls and set them close together.
  5. Bake at 180°C until just cooked and still pale, about 15 minutes.
  6. Cool under a cloth so the crust stays soft.

Adjusted

A pinch of sugar is not allowed, and a hard crust is a choking risk. The crust must stay soft.

Use a teaspoon of mashed apple to feed the yeast instead of sugar, and add no salt. The apple replaces the sugar. Bake the rolls only until cooked and still soft.
